profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000033185. Its site describes it as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores to both businesses and consumers.

The company says it also offers identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product it calls Equifax Complete, and it states that dedicated ID Restoration Specialists work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. Much of the site is educational material about credit reports and scores, financial behavior, debt, credit cards, personal finance, loans, and fraud and identity theft, with a section of Spanish-language content on Equifax credit reports, credit scores, and money management. The site text describes no AI products or services.

Litigation records associated with the company count 105 cases in Georgia.
